```sql
WITH bethlehem_pa AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Bethlehem'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND addr_state = 'PA'
),
hospitals_in_bethlehem AS (
  SELECT pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN bethlehem_pa
    ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, bethlehem_pa.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.amenity = 'hospital'
    AND pois.addr_city = 'Bethlehem'
    AND pois.addr_state = 'PA'
),
nature_reserves_in_bethlehem AS (
  SELECT pois.geometry
  FROM pois
  JOIN bethlehem_pa
    ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geometry, bethlehem_pa.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE pois.leisure = 'nature reserve'
    AND pois.addr_city = 'Bethlehem'
    AND pois.addr_state = 'PA'
),
hospital_elevations AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(
      ST_Clip(
        rast,
        true,
        (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM hospitals_in_bethlehem LIMIT 1)
      ),
      1
    ) AS stats
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM hospitals_in_bethlehem LIMIT 1)
  )
),
nature_reserve_elevations AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(
      ST_Clip(
        rast,
        true,
        (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserves_in_bethlehem LIMIT 1)
      ),
      1
    ) AS stats
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    rast,
    (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM nature_reserves_in_bethlehem LIMIT 1)
  )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT stats->'sum' FROM hospital_elevations) / (SELECT stats->'count' FROM hospital_elevations) AS avg_elevation_hospitals,
  (SELECT stats->'sum' FROM nature_reserve_elevations) / (SELECT stats->'count' FROM nature_reserve_elevations) AS avg_elevation_nature_reserves,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT stats->'sum' FROM hospital_elevations) / (SELECT stats->'count' FROM hospital_elevations) >
         (SELECT stats->'sum' FROM nature_reserve_elevations) / (SELECT stats->'count' FROM nature_reserve_elevations)
      THEN 'hospitals'
    ELSE 'nature reserves'
  END AS higher_category;
```
